name: Jeush
title: Son of Ezek from the tribe of Benjamin
summary: Jeush was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Ezek, who was a descendant of King Saul through his grandson Merib-Baal (Mephibosheth). He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin. His significance lies primarily in his place in the genealogical line from Saul.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jeush is listed as one of the three sons of Ezek in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, as a descendant of King Saul.

keyEvents.title: The warrior reputation of the family
keyEvents.description: Jeush's brother Ulam is described as the father of sons who were skilled warriors and archers, indicating that the family had military significance.

keyEvents.title: Genealogy from Saul
keyEvents.description: Jeusj belonged to the lineage of King Saul through Jonathan and Merib-Baal, and his father Esek was a son of Asel in this line.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Benjamin's Register Repeated
keyEvents.description: The genealogical record where Jeusj is mentioned is also repeated in 1 Chronicles chapter 9, as part of the overview of those who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.
